text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today is Valentine's Day.
A day when extra-special sweets are passed around.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, out of sheer curiosity, I came to take a peek at the department store basement event hall, but—

Come on, hang in there, Trainer!
The important thing is to dive right in without getting discouraged~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, what a coincidence♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: You two are here too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm currently on a date~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's not it...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just being dragged around.
To cafes with decorations that hurt your eyes...
To stalls selling nothing but neon-colored junk...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, on Valentine's Day, the whole town is packed full of heart-throbbing, picture-perfect spots, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've got you tagging along
for a full day of Curren's top recommendations♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"You're definitely thinking of something way off the mark right now,
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's not it either.
It's just—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—So, um.
About what happened before the Kikuka Sho... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I was completely in the wrong.
...I was the one taking it out on you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sniffle... *hic*... Curren was so...
so, so terribly sad, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san said things back then that made it sound like she wouldn't mind if she just died...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren... Curren is...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm sorry.
I don't think that way anymore, so...
I really don't... and I won't ever say it again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I will not forgive you!!
I was really, really worried about you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I see. You don't have to forgive me.
You have every right to—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I won't accept you staying like this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So as an apology, could Curren have
a whole, whiiile lot of your time, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Still, this is merely an 'apology' to this girl.
Nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, don't say that.
You should try to enjoy yourself a little too, Ayabe-san."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today, Curren's gonna take you to show you
sooo many places, things, and experiences
that you've never known before, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then, you might just find some "things you love"
that you'd never noticed before, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Don't you think things like that... might be important for "the Ayabe-san of today"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's words echoed strangely in the silence,
suddenly bringing back memories of a past conversation with Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Desires of "myself" that had nothing to do with running...
nothing to do with the duties I had to fulfill...
I wanted to ignore them as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Because doing that—looking away, ignoring it—
is how I've always gotten by, so—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...At this point, asking myself 'what do I want to do'... 
...I just don't know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Piece by piece, she gathered up the parts of herself she had ignored and discarded. For Admire Vega, who was finally trying to truly live—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Finding what you like
might indeed be important."
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you to look after Ayabe, Curren
Take care of Ayabe for me, Curren

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
!
Aha, okaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, on to the next spot we go!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Hey!
Wait up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, night fell.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...We sure run into each other a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No. I went back to the dorm once with Curren-san...
and just came back out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I was thinking of going stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since they disappeared...
Ever since we couldn't talk anymore,
I haven't gone there much, but..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: After Curren-san dragged me around all day... somehow, it just came to me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I was thinking maybe I'd go.
choice_data_list: Then Ayabe must really like that.
Then Ayabe must really like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I see.
...So that's how it is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her fondly as she murmured to confirm it to herself,
a vending machine suddenly caught my eye.
...Since I'm here, maybe I should get her a little treat.
choice_data_list: Why not bring along a warm drink?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm buying one too, so I'll just grab yours while I'm at it."
I add this so she won't feel reserved, and wait for her response. Then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Oolong tea, then, please.
...Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She answered me far more casually
than I had imagined.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should try stargazing from my room too?
Thinking this, I watch her walk away with a slight spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Then oolong tea—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...No.
What will you have?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked for my thoughts, I reflect.
That's when I recall the event hall from earlier today—
choice_data_list: Since it's Valentine's Day, maybe I'll go with cocoa.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What a weird way to decide.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Then I'll have the same.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking the can, Admire Vega trotted off toward the hill—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...My mouth tastes so sugary sweet.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, what a weird way to decide.
